title: Kokoro
hero_prompt: Wide darkened backdrop, a single human mouth in mid-speech rendered as a clean ink diagram — cross-section of vocal tract with waveform ripples emanating outward, layered like a silkscreen print in two or three colors (deep charcoal ground, one warm tone, white line). The waveform trails off into phoneme notation symbols abstracted into pure geometric marks. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial. No CGI, no glossy surfaces, no photorealism.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem: a stylized mouth-opening shape (ellipse) with a single sine-wave line cutting through it horizontally, rendered as a thick woodcut mark on dark ground. Must survive at 24px — no fine linework, no text, no numerals, purely geometric.
